verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Devin publishes an llms.txt at docs.devin.ai (HTTP 200). It indexes agent-consumable markdown bundles per section, such as Desktop (100 pages) and API, so a user can point an agent at it directly. Doc pages are also served as .md URLs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
